record.title: Evaluate two-word observation and choose the next bounded question
record.intent: Separate demonstrated composition from unresolved downstream transformation and instrument semantics.
requirements: Do not treat synthetic data or static predictions as physical instrument evidence.
acceptance: State whether the stock observation supports the predicted composition and where execution stopped.
Evaluate stop coverage, unresolved helper behavior and any unexpected architecture evidence.
Commit and push conclusions before another experiment; leave any successor explicitly proposed or admitted.
